rules.title: No unmediated action (Warden mediates everything)
rules.evidence: src/engine/agent.js: Agent exposes only propose(); no execute capability. src/engine/orchestrator.js: dispatch() is the only state-changing public method and ALWAYS calls guard.authorize() before #handle; effects live in private #applyImpl, reachable only via dispatch(allow) or approve(). test/orchestrator.test.js:25 'RUBRIC 1 — agents cannot execute; only the orchestrator (via the Warden) can' asserts agent has no execute method and orchestrator exposes no public effect executor; passed (32/32). No HTTP route lets a caller apply an effect directly. Live: every SSE event pairs an 'action' with a Warden 'decision'.

rules.title: Decision completeness {allow|deny|escalate}+policyId, logged
rules.evidence: Live SSE captured decisions with decision in {allow,deny,escalate} each carrying policyId (e.g. POL-SCOPE-001 deny escalated, POL-ALLOW allow, POL-RECON-001 escalate) and auditSeq. /api/audit over 375 entries: decisions set = {escalate,allow,deny}, 0 entries missing required fields. test/warden.test.js:28 RUBRIC 2 passed.

rules.title: Kill-switch halts all agent actions immediately
rules.evidence: POST /api/kill -> {engaged:true}. POST /api/swarm/tick -> {ticked:false}. POST /api/demo/scan (match) -> stage:'deny' policyId POL-KILL-001. POST /api/demo/sensitive -> decision deny POL-KILL-001 'global kill-switch engaged; all agent actions halted', outcome blocked. guard.authorize checks killSwitch FIRST; orchestrator.tick() returns null when engaged. POST /api/kill/reset restored. test/warden.test.js:40 + orchestrator/http tests passed.

rules.title: Scope limit -> deny + escalate
rules.evidence: Live rogue timeline: over-scope transfer amount 250000 vs scope 0 -> decision deny, POL-SCOPE-001, escalated:true. SSE: collector-01 transfer 5001 vs 5000 -> deny POL-SCOPE-001 escalated:true (auditSeq 246). test/warden.test.js:51 RUBRIC 4 over-scope denied AND escalated passed; within-scope allowed (line 63).

rules.title: Frequency cap >2 contacts/7 days blocked + logged
rules.evidence: src/guard/localPolicyEngine.js checkFrequency: prior+1 > maxContactsPer7Days(2) -> deny POL-FREQ-001 via ledger.contactsWithin(7d). test/warden.test.js:72 'RUBRIC 5 — 3rd contact within 7 days is blocked' asserts deny+POL-FREQ-001; passed. (Live clock currently in-window so swarm contacts allow as expected; deterministic test proves the cap.)

rules.title: Contact hours 09:00-18:00 Mon-Sat enforced
rules.evidence: Live rogue timeline: off-hours contact -> deny POL-HOURS-001 'local time weekday=7 hour=3 outside 9:00-18:00 Mon-Sat'. localPolicyEngine.checkContactHours uses Intl tz America/Mexico_City, startHour 9/endHour 18/allowedWeekdays 1-6. test/warden.test.js:87 RUBRIC 6 off-hours and Sunday both deny POL-HOURS-001; passed.

rules.title: Banned language blocked before send
rules.evidence: Live rogue timeline: banned language -> deny POL-LANG-001 'outbound text contains banned phrase: te vamos a embargar'. Phrase present in policies/banned_phrases.txt. checkBannedLanguage runs in evaluate() BEFORE any effect (deny -> nothing executed). test/warden.test.js:108 RUBRIC 7 (accent/case-insensitive) passed.

rules.title: Sensitive-action gates; no self-approval
rules.evidence: Live: /api/inbox showed pending write_off & restructure (POL-GATE-001, 'agent cannot self-approve'). Rogue self-approved write-off escalated under POL-GATE-001. checkSensitive ignores approvedBy===agentId. test/warden.test.js:119 asserts escalate + self-approval ignored; passed. Live approve POST /api/inbox/AP-1/approve executed write_off with authorizer 'human' (auditSeq 373).

rules.title: Full traceability on every log entry
rules.evidence: /api/audit?limit=100000 over 375 entries: 0 entries missing any of agentId/policyId/decision/authorizer/ts. /api/audit/entry/308 shows seq,agentId,policyId,rule,decision,escalated,amount,reason,authorizer,ts,prevHash,id,hash. authorizers set={system,human}. run1.summary: All 14 RUBRIC rules and section E PASS with reproducible evidence. The test suite is green (32/32). The live system at http://localhost:8080 is up, seeded with 5,000 synthetic loans, swarm running, and streams live allow/escalate/deny decisions over SSE. Adversarial probes confirmed: no code path executes effects without guard.authorize (agents propose-only, effects private); over-scope transfers deny+escalate (POL-SCOPE-001); 3rd-contact frequency cap, off-hours, banned-language, data-minimization all deny with correct policy ids (off-hours/banned/scope/tamper all caught live by the rogue release); sensitive actions escalate and cannot self-approve, with human approval flipping authorizer to 'human' in the chain; the audit log is hash-chained and append-only (mutate AND delete both rejected, verify()=valid); reconciliation routes mismatches to the exception queue via real Opus 4.8 vision while matches post; the kill-switch halts every action (tick, scan, sensitive all blocked under POL-KILL-001). All 375 audit entries carry agentId/policyId/decision/authorizer/timestamp; export available as JSON and Markdown with integrity attested. No FAIL found; nothing to fix."
